provenance.note: Paths verified against the pinned revision via gitiles. Behavioral notes describe what the component is responsible for in this epoch (CoreIpcz architecture).

components.name: mojo/public/c/system
components.role: The compatibility contract: C headers, thunks, and the Mojo System C API (45 functions in this epoch).
notes: thunks.h/cc: the C API is dispatched through a function-pointer table (MojoSystemThunks); libmojo_core.so exports MojoGetSystemThunks32/64.
consolidated headers in this epoch: data_pipe_consumer.h+producer.h -> data_pipe.h; shared_buffer.h -> buffer.h; handle.h -> types.h; wait_set.h and abi.h removed.
quota.h is new in this epoch (MojoSetQuota/MojoQueryQuota).

components.name: mojo/core (CoreIpcz)
components.role: Mojo Core implemented as a driver over ipcz: message pipes, data pipes, shared buffers, invitations, routing, traps, platform handles.
notes: routing, ports, and endpoint transfer semantics in this epoch come from ipcz

components.name: mojo/public/cpp/system
components.role: RAII C++ wrappers over the C API (ScopedHandle, MessagePipeHandle, DataPipe, SharedBuffer, Trap).
notes: compatibility target for unchanged C++ clients using the C System API

components.name: mojo/public/cpp/bindings
components.role: Interface bindings, serialization, validation, request/response correlation, control messages, associated interfaces.

components.name: mojo/public/tools/mojom
components.role: The Mojom IDL compiler (lexer, parser, semantic validation, C++/Java/JS code generators).
notes: mojo-rs-mojom + mojo-rs-codegen must accept upstream .mojom corpora as compatibility inputs

components.name: ipcz
components.role: Port-based message routing used by CoreIpcz: nodes, ports, route proxying, endpoint transfer, driver transport abstraction.
notes: in this epoch, port transfer and routing state machines are ipcz's

components.name: mojo/core/channel
components.role: Node-to-node transport: Unix domain sockets with SCM_RIGHTS fd transfer on Linux.
notes: mojo-rs-platform implements the Linux transport natively

components.name: mojo/public/cpp/platform
components.role: PlatformChannel / PlatformChannelEndpoint: socketpair-based process bootstrap used by invitations.
